plan:
- Microcontroller or SBC like Raspberry Pi 4 with a dedicated motor controller shield for drive and gantry systems.
- Motion system utilizing a vertical lead screw or belt-driven linear rail gantry and dual 6-DOF robotic arms with servo actuators.
- Navigation stack comprising a 2D/3D LiDAR sensor, rotary encoders on DC gear motors, and an IMU for SLAM.
- Structural frame built from aluminum T-slot extrusions to support three tiered trays and a mobile chassis base.
- Power distribution system featuring a 12V or 24V LiFePO4 battery pack, buck converters for 5V logic, and high-current relay modules.
- Custom 3D-printed components including LiDAR mounts, arm brackets, end-effectors, and tray spacers.

projectDescription: This dual-arm mobile manipulator utilizes a wheeled base and LiDAR-guided SLAM for autonomous navigation between industrial storage racks. A lead-screw gantry elevates two 7-DOF brushless arms to access parts across three vertically stacked trays, managed by a Raspberry Pi and CAN-linked motor controllers.
